title: Mirai Botnet Investigation
description: Investigate and contain a Mirai botnet infection affecting the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has been experiencing unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Initial investigations suggest a possible botnet infection. Your task is to investigate and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via the provided cloud environment.
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify the Suspicious Beacon Service
levels.content: Investigate the services running on bot1 and identify the service responsible for beaconing to the C2 server.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious beacon service is named `bot-beacon-Hilix.sh.service`.

hints.title: First Hint
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

levels.title: Identify the Suspicious Flood Service
levels.content: Examine the systemd services on bot1 and find the service that is generating flood traffic.
levels.solution: Look for services related to network diagnostics or similar descriptions. The suspicious flood service is named `bot-flood-Hilix.sh.service`.

hints.title: First Hint
hints.content: Look for services related to network diagnostics or similar descriptions.

levels.title: Contain the C2 Communication
levels.content: Identify the port used for C2 communication and block it to prevent further beaconing.
levels.solution: Check the beacon service configuration for the port number. The port used for C2 communication is `2222`.

hints.title: First Hint
hints.content: Check the beacon service configuration for the port number.
